issue.title: Bug: `fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap` fails on fixed box t2s

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When running `fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap` with the `t2-single-node-min` topology it fails with:
```
E           ======================================================================
E           ERROR: fib_test.FibTest
E           @summary: Send packet for each range of both IPv4 and IPv6 spaces and
E           ----------------------------------------------------------------------
E           Traceback (most recent call last):
E             File "ptftests/py3/fib_test.py", line 623, in runTest
E               self.check_ip_ranges()
E             File "ptftests/py3/fib_test.py", line 196, in check_ip_ranges
E               self.check_ip_range(ip_range, dut_index, ipv4)
E             File "ptftests/py3/fib_test.py", line 243, in check_ip_range
E               src_port, exp_port_lists, _ = self.get_src_and_exp_ports(dst_ip)
E             File "ptftests/py3/fib_test.py", line 203, in get_src_and_exp_ports
E               src_port = int(random.choice(self.src_ports))
E             File "/usr/lib/python3.9/random.py", line 347, in choice
E               return seq[self._randbelow(len(seq))]
E           IndexError: list index out of range
E
E           ----------------------------------------------------------------------
```

The problem here is that in the PTF runner it passes all valid ports as `skip_src_ports`.
```
(Pdb) p cmd
'/usr/local/bin/ptf --test-dir ptftests/py3 fib_test.FibTest --platform-dir ptftests --qlen=20000 --platform remote -t \'fib_info_files=[\'"\'"\'/root/fib_info_all_duts.txt\'"\'"\'];ptf_test_port_map=\'"\'"\'/root/ptf_test_port_map.json\'"\'"\';ipv4=True;ipv6=False;testbed_mtu=1514;test_balancing=True;ignore_ttl=False;single_fib_for_duts=\'"\'"\'multiple-fib\'"\
'"\';switch_type=\'"\'"\'voq\'"\'"\';asic_type=\'"\'"\'broadcom\'"\'"\';skip_src_ports=[2, 4, 6, 20, 23, 31]\' --relax --debug info --log-file /tmp/fib_test.ecmp_member_flap.ipv4.True.ipv6.False.2025-05-09-<IPV6>.log --socket-recv-size 16384'
```

This is because the test assumes the device it's running against has an upstream_LC and a downstream_LC:
```
# --- Identify the DUT and ports from the minigraph facts ---
upstream_lc = duthosts[0].hostname
logging.info("upstream_lc: {}".format(upstream_lc))

all_port_indices = get_all_ptf_port_indices_from_mg_facts(duts_minigraph_facts[upstream_lc])
nh_dut_ports = map_ptf_ports_to_dut_port(nh_ptf_ports, all_port_indices)
filtered_ports = filter_ports(all_port_indices, tbinfo)

...

"skip_src_ports": filtered_ports
```

`all_port_indicies` ends up being all 6 ports in the topology:
```
(Pdb) p all_port_indices
{2: (0, 'Ethernet16'), 4: (0, 'Ethernet32'), 6: (0, 'Ethernet48'), 20: (0, 'Ethernet160'), 23: (0, 'Ethernet184'), 31: (0, 'Ethernet248')}
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap` on a `t2-single-node-min` topology

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap` shouldn't include all ports in the system in the `skip_src_ports` ptf_runner argument

resolution.title: Fix `fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap` to not filter ports on `t2_single_node`
resolution.description:
Extended condition in `filter_ports` to avoid filtering ports on `t2_single_node` topologies as they will be fixed systems as well.

Confirmed the test passes on a `t2_single_node` box:
`sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -u -c fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap -x -e '--pdb'`
```
fib/test_fib.py::test_ecmp_group_member_flap[True-False-1514] PASSED
```
